HOME.TITLE: Presidents and soccer in Colombia
HOME.LEAD: A visual journey that connects the governments of Colombia with key episodes of national football. Explore each stage and discover how sports have reflected our history, based on the Secret Histories episode: the presidents and football by Alejandro Pino Calad and Wallas.
